# SEO workspace

Start with your website and goals. This workspace contains reusable methods, not another company's research.

- [Business context](00-context/README.md): company facts learned together.
- [Starting voice](00-context/voice-guide.md): proposed style to adapt.
- [Publishing plan](00-context/publishing-spec.md): choose the destination when needed.
- [Editorial workspace](apps/seo-workspace/index.html): Knowledge, Discoveries, Briefs, Drafts, Published and Setup.
- [Work requests](playbooks/editorial-workspace/README.md): how app requests reach the agent.
- [Owner decisions](decisions.md) and [next steps](open-items.md): agreements and unfinished work.
- 01-research/: findings and raw evidence.
- 02-pipeline/: production-owned briefs and drafts.
- 03-published/: verified live-page records.
- 04-measurement/: performance and refresh work.
- playbooks/: reusable article, review, cover and research guidance.

Each item has one owning record. App work stays in the app unless an existing production record owns it. This template starts without research, articles, approvals or active schedules.
